study: periodic gyroid cell refinement at constant actual solid fraction
why: The 2026-10-22 sequence held the threshold fixed, so each resolution carried a different actual solid fraction (0.39648 to 0.41204) and the full tensor change tracked that drift rather than discretisation.
target_provenance: the declared design point of the earlier study: the fraction its fixed threshold 0.6170021750539874 produces at the separate 96^3 geometry sampling
cross_check: resolutions 16, 24 and 32 are repeated here against the single-thread sequence; agreeing tensors demonstrate the threading is sound for this build
resolution_64_excluded: N=64 peak solver RSS was 16.81 GiB in the earlier study; this host has 15 GiB total, so N=64 is not attempted here rather than attempted and refused
solver_binary_note: CalculiX 2.21 Linux build from the cadsim image; NOT the pinned Mac ccx_2.21 of the earlier study, so tensors are not expected to match it bit for bit
solver_threads_note: eight threads, declared as a separate extension because the single-thread sequence refused N=48 on the 1200 s cap; the earlier work counted 142/500 wrong multithreaded solves, which its acceptance checks detected, so the same periodic-residual, energy, reaction-work, reciprocity and positivity checks police this run and a wrong solve refuses rather than passes
